The code review is clean. The PR conflicts with main and cannot merge yet.

The resolved post now reaches the stored script options in single-file and multiple-file posting. The tests check retract commands, arc format, sequence numbers, file paths, and warnings. The existing post safety checks remain in use.

Local results:

The trial merge used upstream/main at `1f15f98e7c68cb84e49b80d5d3c1676dcab524ac`. It stopped with this error:

```text
CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in crates/app/src/script/report.rs
Automatic merge failed; fix conflicts and then commit the result.
```

I aborted the merge. All build and test results below apply to the PR head alone. They do not prove the merged result. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed. I selected the suites below for the changed posting paths. I did not run the full quick plan.
- Local test build with `--no-run`: passed for the library and all eight selected integration suites.
- Library: 350 passed, 1 heavy test ignored.
- `between_setups`: 8 passed.
- `cli`: 12 passed.
- `mcp_post_options`: 5 passed.
- `post_script_options`: 7 passed.
- `posting`: 17 passed.
- `scripting`: 18 passed.

- `setup_post_options`: 11 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

This is a safety-tier review because the change affects posted G-code. I repeated two mutations locally:

1. In `post_script_for_post_with_options`, pass `None` in place of `Some(post)`. The test `mcp_post_with_post_name_applies_matching_stored_script_options` failed on the program comparison. The test passed after restoration.
2. In `post_each`, set `explicit_post` to `None`. The test `cam_post_and_cli_and_multi_setup_handle_named_post_script_options` failed on the per-setup program output. The test passed after restoration.

Both temporary mutations were fully removed. No golden files changed. No UI files changed, so before and after screenshots are not required. No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed.

Before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/script/report.rs:49`: resolve the conflict with main when this PR is next in the merge batch. Keep the warning field and the current main result-header behavior. Test the merged result before merge. Leave the branch alone until that point, as the refresh-at-merge-time rule requires.

Non-blocking note: `crates/app/tests/post_script_options.rs:264` grows an existing test file from 266 to 682 lines. Consider a later split by test concern under the 400-line rule.

The PR keeps the `conflicts` label and stays a draft. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The conflict in `crates/app/src/script/report.rs` is resolved by merging `upstream/main` at `1f15f98e7c68cb84e49b80d5d3c1676dcab524ac`. The warning field and main’s shared result-header behavior are both preserved. The incoming per-operation call now extracts script text from the resolved post tuple.

The extended `cam_post_and_cli_and_multi_setup_handle_named_post_script_options` test pins the warning together with path, operation count, line count, returned program, and `cam.report().posted`. Removing the warning failed the test. Removing the recorded output path failed the test. Both passed after restoration.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 1,747 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored. The named per-operation scripting test passed. `cargo clippy -j 2 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Needs changes before merge.

The earlier conflict is resolved. The shared result header, the warning field, and the first output path are preserved. The new assertions pass. However, the per-operation path still drops the stored options when the caller names a post.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/script/api.rs:314`: Preserve the resolved `PostRef` for per-operation output. This branch discards it and calls `post_per_op_script_with_options`. That function sets `use_post` to `false`. Thus, `program_options_for_script` receives no post reference and cannot apply the stored options. The return at line 317 also bypasses the warning check. Apply matching stored options for each operation. Report unapplied options when the caller chooses a different post. Add tests for both cases.

I reproduced this through the local MCP server on the merged tree. I created a face operation on `VMC 3-axis`. Then I called:

```json
["set_post_options", {
  "per_op": true,
  "script_options": {
    "safeRetract": "G53",
    "showSequenceNumbers": "every-block"
  }
}]
```

Results from three calls to `post`:

| Post argument | Retract in the output | Sequence numbers | Warning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Omitted | `G53 G00 Z0.` | Present | None |
| `"Fanuc"` | `G91 G28 Z0` | Absent | None |
| `"Haas"` | `G91 G28 Z0` | Absent | None |

All three calls succeeded. The named Fanuc output must use the stored options. The Haas call must report the unapplied Fanuc options. This is the silent output error described in #2190, now reached through per-operation output.

Local build and test results:

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `a529c455352d8c2d228e3dd83d0e5d42a91ea9b0` succeeded. All results below apply to that merged tree. No GitHub runner was used.

This is a safety-tier review because the change affects posted G-code. I repeated two mutations:

1. Pass `None` instead of `Some(post)` in `post_script_for_post_with_options`. `mcp_post_with_post_name_applies_matching_stored_script_options` failed on the program comparison. It passed after restoration.
2. Set `explicit_post` to `None` in `post_each`. `cam_post_and_cli_and_multi_setup_handle_named_post_script_options` failed on the per-setup program output. It passed after restoration.

Both mutations were removed. The working files match the trial merge. No golden files changed. No UI files changed, so before and after screenshots are not required. No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed.

Non-blocking note: `crates/app/tests/post_script_options.rs:264` grows an existing test file beyond 400 lines. Consider a later split by test concern.

The PR can merge without a conflict, but this finding blocks merge. Set `needs-rework`, remove `conflicts`, and keep the PR as a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Per-operation output now preserves the resolved post identity. Matching stored options apply to every operation. A different named post reports unapplied options in the result and script log.

`per_op_named_post_applies_matching_options_to_every_operation` pins matching Fanuc output against omitted-post output and checks G53 retracts and sequence numbers in both operation files. Discarding the post identity made it fail. Restoring the fix made it pass.

`per_op_different_post_reports_unapplied_options_in_result_and_log` pins the Haas warning, Fanuc option isolation, script logs, and returned programs against disk. Removing the warning made it fail. Restoring the fix made it pass.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 1,749 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored. `cargo clippy -j 2 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed. All temporary mutations were removed.
